block.field: Rise/Fall AI armed — Step Index 100, five ticks. Sixteen price experts mixed by measured skill and gated by the live market regime, with a deep online brain learning from settled windows; an entry needs a positive edge over the payout break-even, side agreement, confidence and the risk gate. Skips explain themselves; every fifth entry prints the realised hit rate.
AI is ready but the entry gate held it — a losing-streak cool-off, the balance percentage, the loss limit or the profit target blocked this entry.
AI session stop — the loss limit, the profit target or the balance rule was reached. Open contracts still settle; restart the bot to begin a new session.
